find: if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value < range.min || value > range.max) return -1;
why: Drops the range check so a board above the axis maximum is clamped into the top bin instead of counted as off-grid. This is not hypothetical: measured over 12 seeds, the `topology` ruleset puts EVERY board off-grid on wallFraction (0.516-0.560 against a shipped envelope of 0.085-0.366). Under the mutation it would land all of them in the edge bins and report a non-zero coverage for a ruleset that never enters the shipped space at all -- a generator that is out of family would read as one with reach.
killedBy: expressive range: the sample never sets its own ruler counts an out-of-range board instead of clamping it into an edge bin
